EloJus browser dependencies

@supabase/supabase-js 2.118.0 — MIT — https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
Package and transitive dependency integrity are pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml.
This SDK sends account credentials and auth requests to the configured Supabase project over HTTPS. Document content remains local.

Quill 2.0.3 — BSD 3-Clause — https://quilljs.com
docx 9.6.1 — MIT — https://docx.js.org
pdfmake 0.2.20 — MIT — https://pdfmake.github.io/docs/0.1/
Roboto font files embedded in vfs_fonts.js — Apache 2.0
Font source/license: https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-2

Licenses are included alongside these browser bundles. Upstream license
headers remain inside the bundles. Registry tarball integrity and the
bundled docx SHA-256 are recorded in manifest.json. The original packages
are not modified. Browser dependencies are served locally; user document
content is not submitted to a remote conversion service.
PDF.js 5.6.205 — Apache 2.0 — https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/ — Local bundle, worker, fonts, CMaps and WASM resources in pdfjs/. Their licenses are retained in that folder.
